plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 61.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. None of the courses on this map carry an official course prerequisite in their published descriptions (all listed as Advisories); prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: La Chicana: Mexican-American Women in Contemporary Society
courses.choice_note: Select one of CHST 148 / CHST 148H per the official map's RHC GE 7b slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). CHST 148 - La Chicana: Mexican-American Women in Contemporary Society; CHST 148H - La Chicana: Mexican-American Women in Contemporary Society Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000).

courses.title: Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences
courses.choice_note: Select one per the official map's RHC GE 2 slot: PSY 190 / STAT C1000 / STAT C1000H (encoded at the published 4.0 slot value). The map notes PSY 190 is the preferred math/quantitative reasoning course for behavioral and social science majors; the notes also allow DSCI 101, FIN 101, MATH 140, MATH 150, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 175, MATH 180, MATH 190/H, PHIL 112/H, PHIL 115. PSY 190 - Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences; STAT C1000 - Introduction to Statistics; STAT C1000H - Introduction to Statistics Honors.

courses.title: Major Elective (Chicana/o/x Studies)
courses.choice_note: First of three identical major 'Select one' slots on the official map (two in 3rd semester, one in 4th). ART 108 - The Art of Mexico; CHST 150 - Chicana/o/x Politics; EGSS 110 - Introduction to Ethnic Studies; EGSS 130 - Introduction to LGBTQ+ Studies; HIST 122 - History of Mexico; HIST 131 - History of the North American Indian; HIST 159 - US Comparative History of Mexican and Asian Americans and Women; HIST 159H - US Comparative History of Mexican and Asian Americans and Women Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); HIST 167 - History of California; HUM 125 - Introduction to Mexican Culture; HUM 125H - Introduction to Mexican Culture Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); HUM 130 - Contemporary Mexican-American Culture; LIT 117 - Mexican Literature in Translation (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); LIT 117H - Mexican Literature in Translation Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); LIT 149 - Introduction to Chicana/o/x Literature (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); LIT 149H - Introduction to Chicana/o/x Literature Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000); MUS 129 - Music in Latin American Culture; POLS 150 - Latinx Politics; SOC 116 - Power, Oppression, and Privilege: Race and Ethnic Relations.
